title: Imports (map/war3map.imp.json, war3campaign.imp.json)
description: The project form of war3map.imp and war3campaign.imp (the Import Manager's list), written by the format definition crates/w3proj/formats/imports.json. Keys the definition doesn't know are allowed: the codec ignores them (they don't reach the packed map).

flags.description: 5/8 standard path, 10/13 custom path (classic); Reforged maps also use 17, 21, 24, 25, 29

path.description: the file's path in the archive

f32.description: a 32-bit float: a number, or "f32:0x" and its 8 hex digits (NaN and infinities keep their bits that way)

cstring.description: a zero-terminated string; it can't hold the zero character

char.description: one printable ASCII character, or empty for a zero byte

id.description: four bytes: four printable ASCII characters ("hfoo"), or "0x" and 8 hex digits

variant.description: a layout choice the codec made reading the file; it stores no bytes
